source_copy_requirements: The source worker must receive a new independently materialized private directory: all 4023 exact acffa regular members plus only the two 54c9 static overlays, total 4025. It may not receive or modify the old qualified/public checkout.

Use ordinary byte copies, no shared hardlinks or alternates. Source admission remains complete path/mode/size/Git-blob verification, with a newly measured SHA256 and identity for every file. No full Git object/consumer/clone claim is made by this development materialization.
Only the top-level .git storage is excluded from source namespace comparison. Unknown files, symlinks, special members and empty extra directories must cause HOLD.

The worker parses the bridge but does not import it or execute any file-reading effect. Only the actual canonical authoring Builder/public Core renderer/verifier are imported; no B0/B3/image/compiler or native tests run.

Evidence is create-only outside the source directory. The worker never writes generated HIA into source; it retains the document and assembly as output originals for a later independently pinned candidate.
